decisions.reason: Although distant from the core maritime offer, the healthcare and hospitality recruitment service was launched only in 2023 and publicly presented on the website, so management, having just committed recruiting infrastructure to it, will likely attribute modest early results to start-up effects and persist for now.

Superyacht crew recruitment leverages the firm's large seafarer network and crewing centres, fits the announced direction toward integrated maritime solutions, and reflects strong commitment, so it will be kept.
